address: 8 rue de la Corne-de-Cerf, Saint-Malo, 35400, France
bio: In his méson (which means house in Gallo, the language of Upper Brittany), the chef-owner goes all out Breton, showcasing seafood and other regional ingredients (buckwheat, lait ribot (Breton buttermilk), Coco de Paimpol beans, salted butter) that he sources locally. Freshness, flavour and a respect for nature....
